mu_name_from: aida's object slot: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd, from Data/Object34.
sheet_from: Data/Object34/, decoded under the ai_ prefix by `mu new`.
material_note: waterfall_R: cyan-white streaked water on black, added.
why_this_one: A waterfall, 40 of them, hanging from the pit lips into the dark; its 15-key clip sways the fall. Glow batch (the user, 2026-10-11: 'Glow sheets batch'). docs/aida-port.md.
additive_from: An _R sheet: MU's TextureScript marks a name with _R after its underscore bright (TextureScript.cpp:16-58) and RenderBody makes that mesh the blend mesh (ZzzBMD.cpp:2236-2242), so it is drawn added, as Tarkan's chogatea02_R.
glow_from: MoveAidaObject, types 25 and 28: BlendMeshTexCoordV -= 0.015 a frame (GMAida.cpp:48-57). At MU's 25 reference frames a second that is 0.375 sheet a second, V falling, MU's usual direction, so positive here: the water runs down.
effects_note: The spray beside it is Object57-59's (hidden emitters, still to come).
